provenance: Balbaa2022 (DOI 10.3390/jmmp6010002), transcribed 2026-07-29 from repo copy references/docs/Balbaa2022_multiscale-RS-LPBF-IN625_JMMP-6-2.pdf; page/table refs below are to that PDF
quarantine_note: V1-only inputs. These values reproduce Balbaa's ABAQUS model and MUST NOT leak into the main AMB2018-01 case inputs (D-01/D-08 sources differ). See SPEC.md 'Input quarantine'.
units_policy: SI unless stated in the field name; values transcribed as printed, unit typos in the paper are registered in deviations.yaml (D-V1-06), not corrected here

solid_thermal_conductivity_W_mK.note: full T-curve NOT printed in Balbaa2022, only the range; see deviations.yaml D-V1-01

solid_density_kg_m3.note: range printed high-to-low (density falls with T); full curve not printed, D-V1-01

solidus_K.note: = 1290 C; used as melt-pool boundary iso-surface (Sec 3.2, p.12)

latent_heat_fusion.note: unit as printed is dimensionally wrong for a latent heat; D-V1-06

ambient_temperature_K.note: Table 1 value; Sec 2.2.2 text says 'assumed 300 K' and Sec 2.6.2 says 40 C -- internally inconsistent, D-V1-05

table2_optical_penetration_depth.provenance: Balbaa2022 Table 2 (p.6), measured for pure Ni by [53] Fischer et al. 2003 Acta Mater 51:1651-1662

used_value.derivation: linear interpolation to the IN625 PSD of -45 um used in the experiments [50]; paper justifies transfer from Ni by IN625 being 58% Ni (Sec 2.4, p.6)

wavelength_nm.provenance: Balbaa2022 Sec 3.1 (p.12), Yb-fiber laser of EOS M280

absorptivity.provenance: Balbaa2022 Sec 3.1 (p.12): DRS / Kubelka-Munk measurement on the IN625 powder at 1070 nm

spot_radius.provenance: NOT GIVEN anywhere in Balbaa2022 (r appears symbolically in Eq 17-18)
spot_radius.note: blocking parameter for reproducing Eq 18; see deviations.yaml D-V1-02

heat_source_models.goldak_eq16: Qv = (6*sqrt(3)*Ac*P) / (a*b*c*pi*sqrt(pi)) * exp(-[3(x-vt)^2/a^2 + 3(y-h)^2/b^2 + 3z^2/c^2]); a=b=laser spot radius, c=experimental melt pool depth

symbols.h: hatch spacing (0 for single track on symmetry plane)

heat_source_models.selected_by_paper: exponential (Eq 18), chosen after the Fig 8-10 comparison

powder_bed_model.conductivity: Sih-Barlow (Eq 12) with radiation term kr = 4*eps*sigma*T^3*Dp / (1 - 0.132*eps) (Eq 13); stagnant N2 in voids
powder_bed_model.emissivity: powder-bed emissivity from Eq 9-11: e = AH*eH + (1-AH)*es, AH = 0.908*phi^2/(1.908*phi^2 - 2*phi + 1)

melt_pool_effective_conductivity.model: keff = kl + h*L (Eq 19); h from Nu = 1.6129*ln(Ma) - 10.183 (Eq 21); Ma per Eq 22 with dT from Eq 23; L = half melt pool width; dt = L/v (Eq 24)
melt_pool_effective_conductivity.note: anisotropic detail: paper says Marangoni approximated 'based only on the outward flow in the melt pool width direction' (p.14); exact implementation direction ambiguous, D-V1-10

validation_variant_powder_layer_um.provenance: Balbaa2022 Sec 3.2 (p.12): geometry modified to 20 um layer to match NIST [68] / Dilip [69] experiments

single_track_model.symmetry: XZ plane (track centerline), halves the domain
single_track_model.heat_input: volumetric body flux on powder layer via DFLUX
single_track_model.state_switching: USDFLD: SV 0=powder (T<Tmelt), 1=liquid (T>Tmelt), 2=solid (T<Tmelt after Tmax>Tmelt); 'Tmelt' not defined as solidus or liquidus in the paper, D-V1-04
single_track_model.melt_pool_extraction: at steady state (constant peak T); boundary = 1290 C solidus contour

initial_condition_C.provenance: Balbaa2022 Sec 2.1 (p.3), Eq 2 preheat; not re-stated for the single-track model specifically, D-V1-05

single_track_model.convection_bc: forced N2 over flat plate, Eq 4-7; U_inf = 3 m/s (p.3); W = 250 mm (EOS M280 bed width); gas properties at film temperature (Pr, nu curves not tabulated, D-V1-10)
single_track_model.radiation_bc: Eq 8 with powder-bed emissivity from Eq 9-11

reported_validation_results.provenance: Balbaa2022 Sec 4.1, Figs 8-10 (p.14-15); text-stated values exact, bar-chart values digitized from 200 dpi render, see deviations.yaml D-V1-09

validation_case_process_parameters.note: P and v of the 20-um-layer validation runs are NOT stated in the paper; D-V1-03. NIST AMB2018-02 cases were A:150W/400mm/s, B:195W/800mm/s, C:195W/1200mm/s.

paper_interpretation_notes: depth underestimated by all three sources; paper attributes NIST's deeper pools to bare-substrate printing (no powder layer) while the model kept a 20 um powder layer (p.14), D-V1-07
length underestimated ~2x; paper attributes it to the width-direction-only Marangoni approximation (p.14)
cooling rate ~1e5 K/s order, Figs 12-13, reported for the 140-270 W parameter study, not per NIST case

external_experiment_references.dilip_69: Dilip et al. 2016, Solid Freeform Fabrication Symposium, Austin TX ('A short study on the fabrication of single track deposits in SLM and characterization'); note SPEC.md cites this as 'Dilip et al. 2017' -- the Balbaa reference list says 2016
